paragraphs.text: On 12 November 2026, the Indian government reduced the number of main visa categories from 13 to 9.
The visa system was previously simplified in October of last year.

Main visa categories were reduced from 22 to 13 and sub-categories from 63 to 49 in October of last year, Food reduced the number of main visa categories from 13 to 9 and sub-categories from 49 to 23, Required information and column numbers for all 23 visa categories and sub-categories were reduced by 65 to 70 percent, Interior said.
On 11 November 2026, the Ministry of Home Affairs reduced the number of questions in visa application forms by 65% to 70%.
On 11 November 2026, the Ministry of Home Affairs reduced the main visa categories from 13 to 9.
On 12 November 2026, the Indian government reduced the number of visa sub-categories from 49 to 23.
"The purpose of the step to increase foreign tourists, medical patients, and foreign students," Interior Ministry said.
The government aims to start the process of issuing visas under the revised structure by the end of this year, Interior Ministry said.
The new visa issuance system was expected to begin by the end of 2026.

12 नवंबर 2026 को, भारत सरकार ने वीजा उप-श्रेणियों की संख्या 49 से घटाकर 23 कर दी।
